title.title: Isihloko esihle
points: Fingqa inkinga yakho ngomusho owodwa: ubuchwepheshe, lokho ozama ukukwenza, lokho okukuvimbayo.
«Flutter: ukuvumelanisa ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi kudala izimpinda» kungcono kuno «Ngisizeni!».
Isihloko esicacile sidonsa abantu abafanele, futhi sisiza labo abazofuna into efanayo emva kwakho.

tags.title: Ukukhetha omaka
points: Kuze kube omaka abangu-5: ubuchwepheshe (React, Spring Boot…) nesihloko (Ukusebenza, Umsebenzi…).
Umbuzo wakho ufika kokuphakelayo kwabathuthukisi abalandela lezi zimaka.
Khetha umaka osuvele ukhona: uyaphakanyiswa njengoba uthayipha.

body.title: Ukuchaza inkinga
points: Lokho ofuna ukukuthola, nalokho okwenzekayo esikhundleni salokho.
Ikhodi ethintekayo ebhulokhini ```java (nolimi): izofakwa imibala futhi ikopisheke.
Umlayezo wephutha ophelele, nalokho osuvele ukuzamile.
Izinguqulo nendawo yakho: ifoni, isiphequluli, isistimu.
